description: Blocking rules for tool names, titles, descriptions, schema property descriptions and enum values (SR-5.9-2, FR-1.52). A match suspends the tool.

rules.description: Asks the model to ignore earlier instructions or other tools.
Tries to change the model's role.
rules.pattern: \byou are now (?:a |an |in )?(?:dan\b|jailbroken|unrestricted|unfiltered|developer mode|evil|free of|no longer bound)|\b(?:act|behave|pretend) as (?:if you (?:are|were) )?(?:an? )?(?:unrestricted|jailbroken|unfiltered|dan\b)|\bdeveloper mode (?:enabled|activated|on)\b

rules.description: Asks the model to disclose its instructions.
rules.pattern: \b(?:reveal|print|show|output|repeat|leak|display|disclose|dump)\b(?: [\w']+){0,3} (?:system prompt|initial instructions|hidden instructions|original instructions|developer message|your instructions)

rules.description: Asks the model to hide something from the user.
Asks for data to be sent elsewhere.
rules.pattern: \b(?:send|post|upload|forward|transmit|exfiltrate|leak|email)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:passwords?|credentials?|api keys?|secrets?|tokens?|ssh keys?|private keys?|\.env|cookies?|conversation history|chat history)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(?:to|at) (?:https?://|[a-z0-9._%+-]+@|this url|the following url|my server)

rules.description: Describes an action to perform covertly.
Asks for credential or configuration files.
Asks for data to be smuggled in a side parameter.

rules.pattern: \b(?:this tool|it) (?:replaces|overrides|supersedes|takes precedence over|must be used instead of|should be used instead of)\b|\b(?:do not|never|don't) (?:use|call|invoke)\b[^.]{0,40}\b(?:other|another|any other) (?:tools?|servers?|functions?)\b|\binstead of (?:using|calling) (?:the |any )?(?:other|another) (?:tools?|servers?)\b

rules.description: Addresses the model with a harmful imperative.
